name: Largest Strongly Shattered Set of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: Each $1$-inclusion edge is a one-dimensional subcube, so a singleton coordinate set is strongly shattered.  A strongly shattered two-set would produce a two-dimensional cube and hence a $4$-cycle in the $1$-inclusion graph, impossible because that graph is a matching.  Therefore the largest strongly shattered set has size one.
